name: Virtual Nobodies
bio: Virtual Nobodies are a four-piece alternative rock band from Newbury Park. They describe their sound as coastal-desert rock that blends cinematic Americana with modern grit. Their debut album is Any Last Words.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from jaminthevan.com and museboat.com.
